title: Completed perfect realization is fully faithful and left adjoint to point sections
statement: Let D, l and E be as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], with l different from the characteristic. There exists a functor from the bounded finitely generated derived-complete O_E module complexes of [def-weil-point-fg-complete-complexes] to integral constructible complexes on Spec(D.k), left adjoint to the specified integral fibre functor, whose adjunction unit is invertible at every object. No assertion about the counit on arbitrary integral constructible complexes is included.

proof.text: Specialize point_exact_extension_sections to n = 1 and integral = true. This supplies the normalized completed extension L, its exactness, and its exact adjunction with the actual integral point sections functor. Derive this adjunction termwise.

source.place: pointIntegralPerfectRealization; specialization of the two point-derived-Hom theorems and transport through ShrinkHoms.equivalence

proof.text: Let e be the canonical equivalence from the standard module-derived category to its small Grothendieck model. The homology comparison for e and its counit transport bounded finitely generated cohomology of an object M of pointFgComplete to e.inverse(M). The integral forward clause of pointSectionsReconstruction then gives invertibility of the derived unit and integral constructibility of the derived extension of e.inverse(M). No counit assertion is required.

source.place: pointIntegralPerfectRealization; specialization of the two point-derived-Hom theorems and transport through ShrinkHoms.equivalence

proof.text: Both the standard derived sections functor followed by e.functor and the small derived sections functor factor the same termwise sections functor on complexes. Localization.liftNatIso supplies their natural isomorphism. Whisker with e.inverse and its unit to identify the ambient right adjoint with the specified small sections functor followed by e.inverse.

source.place: pointIntegralPerfectRealization; specialization of the two point-derived-Hom theorems and transport through ShrinkHoms.equivalence

proof.text: Lift the derived extension along the full inclusion of integral constructible objects using the constructibility just proved. Restrict the derived adjunction along the fully faithful functors pointFgComplete.ι followed by e.inverse and sfIntegralConstructible.ι, using the right-adjoint comparison from the preceding step. The image of its unit is the ambient unit composed with isomorphisms; it is therefore an isomorphism. Fully faithful reflection of isomorphisms proves that the restricted unit is invertible, and the restricted right adjoint is exactly pointIntegralFibre.

lean.statement:
theorem pointIntegralPerfectRealization
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    ∃ L : (DerivedCategory.pointFgComplete
        (ULift.{u + 1, u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
        (Ideal.span {ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)})).FullSubcategory ⥤
        sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E (Spec (.of D.k)),
      ∃ a : L ⊣ pointIntegralFibre D l hl E, ∀ M, IsIso (a.unit.app M)
